Lena Park: Follow-up from authz postmortem - we have three tracked remediations: token validation hardening, audit-event coverage for fallback paths, and rotation alert reliability. Proposing weekly quick-checks until closed.

Ravi Singh: I9ll own token validation. Plan: add stricter expiry checks, unit + integration tests simulating clock skew, and a CI gate. ETA 2026-04-05.

Tess Howard: I9ll take audit coverage. Will run a coverage report, add missing emit points, and ensure request_id/user_id are present. ETA 2026-04-12.

Lena Park: Please paste compact action items for tracker and set SLAs. Suggest: token=P1 2w, audit=P2 4w, rotation=P1 2w.

Ravi Singh: Action: Owner=Ravi Singh; Task=Token strictness + tests; ETA=2026-04-05; Blocker=edge-proxy test access.

Tess Howard: Action: Owner=Tess Howard; Task=Audit emit coverage + schema enforcement; ETA=2026-04-12; Blocker=one consumer drops extra fields (ENG-1022).

ops-bot: Created items: R-3301, R-3302, R-3303. Weekly reminder set Wed 09:00 UTC starting 2026-03-25.

Lena Park: Also: add Grafana panels for token_fail_rate by service and heatmap for last_emit_ts per event. Ravi/Tess to add queries.

Ravi Singh: Will start with `sum(rate(token_validation_failures_total[5m])) by (service)` and add ttl_bucket.

Tess Howard: I9ll export last_emit_ts to Grafana and prototype a heatmap. If downstream drops fields, will add a shim to re-inject minimal identity fields.

Lena Park: Thanks. I9ll update the postmortem follow-up section and add SLAs in the tracker. If any blocker remains, flag in the weekly triage.
